title: Discipline, starting from a model, and brass band influence
summary: Modern players struggle with the discipline of the style; DeVore discusses the Pee Wee Irwin George Lewis imitation, choosing a model, Jelly Roll's band-style piano and brass band roots.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
